title: A Daring Deception
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume Harlequin manga adapted from an Amanda Browning novel. Rachel loves her coworker Nathan, who coldly believes she is a scheming, promiscuous woman. When her grandmother's old love letters are stolen and threaten a scandal, Rachel travels with Nathan posing as his girlfriend to get them back; MangaUpdates tags mention blackmail and gambling.
life_message: Loyalty to family and patience in the face of misjudgment reveal a person's true character.
